hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: An edge belongs to a shortest path between vertices 0 and n - 1 if and only if the sum of distances from 0 to u, the edge weight, and the distance from v to n - 1 equals the overall shortest path length.

hints.title: Two-Source Distances
hints.text: Compute shortest distances from node 0 to all vertices, and from node n - 1 to all vertices using priority queues.

hints.title: Edge Evaluation
hints.text: For each undirected edge between u and v with weight w, check dist0[u] + w + distN[v] == total_dist or dist0[v] + w + distN[u] == total_dist.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Two Dijkstra runs followed by linear edge checks.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all paths between 0 and n - 1 takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(V + E) memory for adjacency list and distance arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use bidirectional distance equality dist(0, u) + w + dist(v, n-1) == total_dist.
